messages:
maya: FYI Acme hit production parse errors in JSON-mode + auth blips + token billing spike. Repro bundle linked. thread_ts=1724123456
liam: can you paste raw response and headers (omit token)? :eyes:
maya: raw body from logs: ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8

{"items": [{"id": 1, "name": "Widget\u2019s"}, {"id":2, "name": "Gadget",}, ]}```
Headers: X-Region: us-east-1, X-Auth-Env: prod
billing: noticed ~4x token jump correlated to retry window
olivia: that payload has trailing comma + smart quote -> JSON.parse will fail. Auth 401s also present, maybe key rotation or invalid sub claim. Any auth event logs?
maya: 401s start at ~1724123465 for ~2m, intermittent. Auth logs show missing/subclaim mismatch for a handful of calls.
jordan: short-term mitigations: proxy sanitizer, short auth grace for rotated key, throttle client retries, and re-ask chain with strict-output system prompt.
liam: recommended repair chain (playbook entry):
1) apply lightweight sanitizer regex on raw response (remove trailing commas, convert curly quotes, strip control chars)
2) attempt JSON.parse
3) if parse fails, re-ask model with strict JSON system prompt forcing a fallback error object if uncertain
4) if still failing, fall back to fallback-model (smaller, deterministic) and escalate to eng-runtime
olivia: propose backoff + jitter for re-asks: immediate local sanitize, then 250ms, 800ms, 2s, 6s (max 4 retries). Cap total user-visible delay and emit metrics to billing team to detect retry storms.
maya: customer asks for an SLA-friendly workaround ASAP. Can we deploy an edge sanitizer proxy that returns sanitized content and exposes Retry-After headers?
jordan: yes. Implementation notes: edge lambda or nginx+lua. Sanitizer rules (starter set):
- remove trailing commas: regex replace ",\s*([\]}])" -> "$1"
- convert smart quotes: [\u2018\u2019\u201C\u201D] -> ' or \"
- strip non-printable control chars: [\x00-\x1F&&[^\n\r\t]] -> ''
- heuristic brace balance: if count('{') > count('}'), append '}'s to balance (log as heuristic fix)
liam: also add streaming sentinel for streaming responses to avoid truncation-induced malformed JSON: append "\n<JSON_END>" from server side and trim client-side after sentinel. Update SDKs to look for sentinel.
maya: billing spike looks like a retry storm from client around 1724123460-1724123470 (multiple immediate retries). We should rate-limit at proxy per-client and add exponential backoff header: Retry-After with computed ms and a short backoff policy.
billing: will annotate billing ticket and flag abnormal token usage; tentative refund hold until root cause confirmed.
olivia: auth audit: there was a key rotation event for tenant at 1724123462 (manual). I'll enable a short 5-minute grace for token validation and notify security.
repro-bot: repro package created: https://repro.internal/r/1724123456 (contains curl + prompt seed + streaming toggle)
repro-bot: curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
 -d '{\"model\":\"x-large\",\"prompt\":\"<schema-only>\",\"mode\":\"json\"}'
```
liam: sample re-ask system prompt for playbook (copy into retry pipeline):
```
System: You MUST ONLY return valid JSON matching the given schema.
System: If you cannot produce valid JSON, return {"__error": "BRIEF_REASON"} and nothing else.
User: Here is the previous response: <raw_response>. Convert it to valid JSON following schema: <schema>.
```
jordan: checklist for engineer triage: check model variant used (quantized vs full), streaming vs non-streaming, runtime kernel retry logs, and client-side retrying behavior. If streaming truncation found, prioritize sentinel change.
maya: owners & short ETAs: olivia: auth grace + audit (30m). maya: deploy sanitizer proxy + client comms (1h). liam: runtime trace + streaming sentinel PR (2h). jordan: escalate to incident if repeats > 3/day.
olivia: updating internal incident ticket with labels: parse-fail, auth-rotation, billing-spike.
maya: drafted customer note: \"We deployed a temporary sanitizer proxy and opened a short auth grace window. We're monitoring token usage and will provide a permanent playbook. Will follow up in 1h.\"
jordan: playbook items to include in postmortem: sanitizer regexes, re-ask prompt templates, sentinel for streaming, per-client rate-limits, metric thresholds for auto-escalation, and sample nginx/lambda code snippets.
liam: quick nginx lua example to strip trailing comma (starter):
```lua
local body = ngx.arg[1]
body = body:gsub(',%s*([%]%}])', '%1')
ngx.arg[1] = body
```
maya: I'll post progress here. Close thread once proxy healthy for 15m and billing stabilized.
summary: Thread: customer reported invalid JSON responses in JSON-mode, intermittent 401s from key rotation, and a token billing spike likely caused by a retry storm. Team proposed edge sanitizer proxy, short auth grace, streaming sentinel, re-ask JSON enforcement prompt, and per-client rate-limits. Owners assigned with short ETAs.
